shortDescription: Creates or removes job buttons from Nautobot

options.name: button_class
options.description: Button class of this button Required if I(state=present) and the job button does not exist yet

options.name: confirmation
options.description: Whether or not a confirmation pop-up box will appear

options.name: content_types
options.description: The content types to associate the job button with Required if I(state=present) and the job button does not exist yet

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether or not the button is enabled

options.name: group_name
options.description: Buttons in the same group will appear in a dropdown menu

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: job
options.description: The job receiver to associate job with Required if I(state=present) and the job button does not exist yet

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the job button Required if I(state=present) and the job button does not exist yet

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: text
options.description: The text to display on the button Required if I(state=present) and the job button does not exist yet

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: weight
options.description: Position this field should be displayed in
